Job Description:
At Bank of America, each day brings innovation and opportunity. We are dedicated to turning technology advances into treasury solutions for our clients globally - across all segments and industries. We are looking for highly motivated, self-starters who can advocate for our clients in providing liquidity management, payments and receipts, trade and supply chain finance, FX and commercial card services, by complementing high tech with a personalized touch. Challenge the status quo and influence peers with diverse points of view. Forward thinkers with ability to see what's next in treasury management. The future of treasury management is here at Bank of America. Powered by people. Driven by Technology.

Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!

The Global Card and Intelligent Payables product team is committed to driving digital payment adoption and creating innovative solutions that help our clients capture and manage spend. This role will sit within the Commercial Card Product Development team, which plays a pivotal role in managing and shaping the commercial card platforms that define how our corporate clients engage with our products. It will be aligned to mobile wallet and global travel products and be responsible for creating and managing digital product strategies, managing relationships with partners who provide our digital card solutions, being the subject matter expert for virtual cards, working with sales to identify opportunities for solution expansion that include virtual cards, and working with B2B product teams to create cross functional solutions. You will reimagine the future of our platforms, ensuring they meet both business goals and compliance standards, while driving revenue and enhancing client experience.
The individual must be comfortable working on technical projects, leading multi-discipline project teams, teaching non-technical partners, communicating value internally and externally, conducting stakeholder impact assessments creating business cases and documenting business requirements, and working with partners to create commercialization materials.

- Define and execute the platform strategy, roadmap, and commercialization plans for mobile wallet, virtual card, and travel payment solutions, aligning investments to client needs, market opportunities, and business objectives
•  Lead the development and enhancement of digital payment capabilities, including mobile wallet provisioning, tokenized payments, virtual card issuance, and travel-related payment experiences
•  Serve as a subject matter expert for virtual card and travel payment solutions, partnering with Global Product, Sales, and Operations to identify opportunities to expand client adoption and wallet share
•  Manage strategic relationships with payment networks, wallet providers, travel technology partners, and third-party vendors to deliver new capabilities and optimize product performance
•  Partner across card, payables, fraud, risk, operations, and technology teams to design digital payment solutions that improve client experience and drive business growth
•  Develop business cases, product requirements, and stakeholder impact assessments to support new products, enhancements, regulatory changes, and platform modernization initiatives
•  Monitor product performance, client feedback, market trends, and competitive offerings to prioritize investments, enhance commercialization strategies, and identify opportunities for innovation.

Job Description:
Job Title: CashPro Product Manager
Corporate Title : Vice President
Location: London

Company Overview
At Bank of America, we are guided by a common purpose to help make financial lives better through the power of every connection. Responsible Growth is how we run our company and how we deliver for our clients, teammates, communities and shareholders every day.
One of the keys to driving Responsible Growth is being a great place to work for our teammates around the world. We’re devoted to being a diverse and inclusive workplace for everyone. We hire individuals with a broad range of backgrounds and experiences and invest heavily in our teammates and their families by offering competitive benefits to support their physical, emotional, and financial well-being.
Bank of America believes both in the importance of working together and offering flexibility to our employees. We use a multi-faceted approach for flexibility, depending on the various roles in our organization.
Working at Bank of America will give you a great career with opportunities to learn, grow and make an impact, along with the power to make a difference. Join us!

London Location Overview
Our London office is based just a stone’s throw from the magnificent St. Paul’s Cathedral on bustling King Edward Street. Here you’ll find modern workspaces and a state-of-the-art auditorium space. In addition, we’re proud to host an onsite restaurant that shares our commitment to sustainability by providing delicious seasonal menus which have been created with the planet in mind. Make sure to take time for yourself and head up to our rooftop terrace and take in the spectacular views across London. Finally, your physical wellness is well-catered for with our onsite gym facilities and medical centre.

Global Payments Solutions Group
Bank of America’s Global Payments Solutions (GPS) business is hiring. Our focus on combining cutting-edge technology with innovative solutions, means we consistently deliver exceptional results for our clients.

Do you want to be part of our award-winning team? We are proud to:
- Be a leading provider of treasury and cash management solutions

- Deliver for over 100,000+ clients globally, including over 73% of the Global Fortune 500

- Be at the forefront of delivering treasury solutions across all segments and all industries, from middle-market businesses to the world’s largest corporate and financial institutions

- Provide a personalised service for our clients, backed with high-tech for their liquidity management, payments and receipts, trade and supply chain finance and FX and commercial card services

We want to hear from you if you are:
- A highly-motivated individual

- Has a client-centric focus who can advocate on their behalf

- Can challenge the status quo

- Collaborate with peers as well as having the ability to influence the conversation with diverse points of view

- Innovative with forward-thinking ideas

Overview
CashPro® is Bank of America’s fully integrated multichannel experience that helps companies improve control, visibility, processing, and scale. CashPro® delivers this experience through multiple channels: CashPro® Online, the CashPro® App, CashPro® API and CashPro® Connect.
This Product Manager role is within the Digital Platforms and Channels team, responsible for Payments, CashPro® Forecasting and Information Reporting, together with User Experience and Access Controls, across the CashPro® Online channel for the EMEA markets.

Responsibilities
- Own and manage the Payments product suite within CashPro® Online for EMEA, including strategy, roadmap and end-to-end lifecycle management, together with the underlying technology infrastructure, external partners and utilities that support it.

- Own CashPro® Forecasting for EMEA, ensuring accurate and timely cash flow forecasting capabilities are delivered to clients and aligned with the global product roadmap.

- Own Information Reporting for CashPro® in EMEA including ensuring regional requirements are documented and form part of the global product roadmap.

- Own the end-to-end User Experience for CashPro® Online, partnering with design and technology teams to improve usability, simplicity and client adoption.

- Manage Access Controls (client entitlements, security profiles and user permissioning) for CashPro® Online, ensuring appropriate governance and risk controls are in place and maintained.

- Comprehensive understanding of the product capability, including user interface, middleware applications, database, payment processing engines, entitlement/access control configurations, as well as all types of customisation preferences we offer to clients.

- Detailed knowledge of competitive landscape and market trends within the channels and payment space.

- Take initiative to develop new products and improve existing offerings based on industry trends and regulations, whilst factoring client feedback.

- Partner with a wide range of stakeholders at different levels within the region and across the globe (Global Product Teams, Sales, Technology, Operations, Compliance, Marketing, and external vendors) to bring to life their vision for the product in conjunction with the firm-wide strategies. Especially close engagement with technology and operations given the technical nature of the product set.

- Provide support in business development efforts by assisting with Request for Information (RFI)/Request for Proposal (RFP) responses and sales presentations and conduct client engagements in order to help effectively on-board and optimize their CashPro® experience.

- Participate in product planning sessions and enhancement roadmap discussions by providing voice-of-the-client feedback, bring unique experiences and knowledge to the discussion.

- Close collaboration with other product managers within the region and across the globe in adjacent subject matter areas, such as Receivables, CashPro® Service, CashPro® Administration, Transactional Foreign Exchange, and Liquidity, given the interdependencies with Payments, Forecasting and Information Reporting.

- Ability to build business cases among competing priorities, to influence the product strategy both at the regional and global level, to drive global consistency, enhance capability, improve user experience, and facilitate operational efficiencies.

- Lead on responses to internal audit and risk reviews, manage risk parameters and be responsible for regulatory reporting that is relevant to the product set; identify and remediate issues and regulatory change, via forum such as impact assessments and project implementation.

What we are looking for
- Experience in a comparable business, ideally within a financial institution, or other payments business also considered, ideally in a technology-based product management capacity.

- Advanced knowledge of bank treasury services product, operating and connectivity platforms, products and capabilities, and a strong understanding of client processes and back-office systems, particularly across payments, cash forecasting and reporting platforms

- Experience owning or influencing digital User Experience, ideally partnering directly with UX/UI design teams, running client usability research or journey mapping, and translating client feedback into product/design requirements.

- Experience/appreciation for the complexities from global operations and legacy systems, with cross border and multi-jurisdictional exposure.

- Experience in technology middleware and system design, as well as understanding the role technology plays within the payments landscape in terms of both innovations and regulation.

- Experience in both technical and non-technical project management, meeting deadlines and pushing product development to market in a timely fashion.

- Risk Manager who is keen attention to spotting risks and issues, as well as taking action to address or remediate systematically.

- Comfortable setting priorities and working on longer-term initiatives, regular routines and dealing with ad hoc unforeseen demands both internally and externally.

- Ability to voice up for the region; proficient in making business cases among competing priorities across different product teams, to influence team members both within region and globally in an effective way with an evidence-based approach.

- Excellent communicator with both written and verbal communication, able to tailor approach to audiences; with the ability to translate context between technical and non-technical teams and be able to clearly communicate and influence clients and business partners while maintaining strong relationships.

- Commitment to personal accountability, taking responsibility for actions and decisions, fulfilling your obligations, tasks, and goals.

- Background or working exposure to EBICS and/or Transactional Foreign Exchange (TFX) would be an advantage

UK

- Competitive pension plan, life assurance and group income protection cover if you become unable to work as a result of a disability or health reasons

- 20 days of back-up childcare including access to school holiday clubs and 20 days of back-up adult care per annum

- The ability to change your core benefits as well as the option of selecting a variety of flexible benefits to suit your personal circumstances including access to a wellbeing account, travel insurance, critical illness etc.

- Access to an emotional wellbeing helpline, mental health first aiders and virtual GP services.

- Access to an Employee Assistance Program for confidential support and help for everyday matters

- Ability to donate to charities of your choice directly through payroll and the bank will match your contribution

- Opportunity to access our Arts & Culture corporate membership program and receive discounted entry to some of the UK’s most iconic cultural institutions and exhibitions.

- Opportunity to give back to your community, develop new skills and work with new groups of people by volunteering in your local community.
